stem: Which sentence from "A Sweet Part of Nature" best shows a way that honeybees are similar to bats?
instruction:
Read this sentence from paragraph 2 of "Night Flyers."

Bats also spread pollen among flowering plants.

options.label: F
options.text: When people think of bees, they may also think of the sweet taste of the honey that bees make.

options.label: G
options.text: The wildflowers and plants that bees feed on have been replaced with crops, which limits honeybees’ access to nectar and pollen.

options.label: H
options.text: Bees pollinate a wide variety of plants in the United States.

options.label: J
options.text: People can grow flowers and plants that honeybees like, such as cabbage, sunflowers, and strawberries.

visual_elements: Bats also spread pollen among flowering plants.
